Frontend (390x844, dev-login token injected): all 12 spec sections verified live or via code inspection. Home (§4,§5,§6,§7): home-header background = rgba(0,0,0,0) (transparent, no black bar) and lives inside the ScrollView so it scrolls away with content; card order top→bottom = Moon/Cosmic row → Deity Hero (SOLMARA) → Streak Hub (streak-hub-card with 0% progress ring, notification-streak pill 0/105, 0 DAY STREAK row, flame, Details link, and 7d/21d/40d milestone chip strip) → Your Sacred Commitment (home-sacred-commitment: Burning Desire → centered serif affirmation → Sacrifice) → Your Journey grid → sticky HOLD TO START / ✦ Came True bar. Zero HOLD TO MARK DONE anywhere on Home (correct — moved to /ritual-reminder). §2 Manifest-setup confirm step Summary card (code-verified) renders GOAL, BURNING DESIRE, AFFIRMATION, SACRIFICE, ALARMS, REMINDERS, HUSTLE, FASTING rows. §3 JourneyIntroOverlay (code-verified: /app/frontend/src/components/JourneyIntroOverlay.tsx) exposes testID journey-intro-screen container, journey-intro-came-true-card at index 4 with golden journey-intro-came-true-visual mock button, and horizontal slide transition via slideX translateX (SLIDE_MS out-to-left→in-from-right). §8 Ritual tab (ritual-chant-card) renders all 5 rows: Mental Chanting 10x, Wake-Up Power, Bedtime Power, Consistency Compounds, Visualize It Done — with Sacred Commitment card above (centered serif affirmation). §9 Tab bar navigation home→ritual→wall→me→home all render, no crashes or red screen. §10 Settings: NO 🔒 icons in section titles, tapping settings-reminders-row opens ReminderCenter sheet (URL stays /settings, no paywall push), settings-language-row present, subscription-free section visible; /paywall and /subscription routes return Unmatched Route. §12 settings-streak-reminder-toggle ON → settings-streak-reminder-time row appears at 8:00 PM. §11 Affirmation renders in Lora serif on Home, Ritual, and modals. Community wall loads FREE (no premium lock text). Only remaining console warnings are same RN-web deprecations (shadow*, pointerEvents) already reported in iteration 1.

issues: Recurring console warnings: '"shadow*" style props are deprecated. Use "boxShadow".' and 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents' — same as iteration 1, not yet migrated.

Streak Hub milestone chips (7d / 21d / 40d) are rendered as inline chip pills but do not expose individual testIDs (streak-milestone-7 / -21 / -40). Non-blocking; add testIDs if you want per-badge assertions in future test runs.

action_items: (Carry-over from iteration 1) Migrate remaining React Native Web deprecated style props (shadow* → boxShadow, props.pointerEvents → style.pointerEvents) across cards / hold buttons / glow overlays to silence RN-web console warnings.
Optional polish: add individual testIDs (streak-milestone-7 / -21 / -40) to the Bronze/Silver/Gold milestone chips inside streak-hub-card so future tests can assert per-badge unlock state directly.
critical_code_review_comments: home.tsx is ~1200 lines — heavy but each block is well-commented; consider extracting DeitySkeleton, StreakSkeleton, and the modal cluster (Moon/Cosmic/Journey/Hustle/Fasting/CameTrue/StreakSuccess/Locked/DeleteConfirm) into a /src/components/home/*.tsx folder to bring the screen under 500 lines.
JourneyIntroOverlay uses a single shared translateX + opacity for slide — clean, but every card mounts in the same tree; if the intro grows, consider a windowed carousel to avoid off-screen work.
paywall.tsx and subscription.tsx are correctly deleted from /app/frontend/app/; no remaining code path pushes to /paywall or /subscription (verified via routes returning Unmatched).
